content: To evaluate our system on irregular examples, we conducted experiments with human tutors from the OMB+ platform. The tutors are experienced regarding rare or complex questions, ambiguous answers, misspellings and other infrequent but still very relevant problems, which occur during a dialogue. In the following, we investigate some common errors and make additional observations.
